courses.title: Go-to-Market Strategy in Practice
courses.description: Go-to-Market Strategy in Practice focuses on go-to-market strategy for people working toward a Product Strategist role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces market research, enough to apply alongside go-to-market strategy in real Product Strategist work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to go-to-market strategy and show how market research supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying go-to-market strategy to a real Product Strategist scenario
Practicing go-to-market strategy through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to market research
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Roadmap Planning for Practitioners
courses.description: Roadmap Planning for Practitioners goes beyond the basics of roadmap planning, for people already working toward a Product Strategist role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in roadmap planning and want to go further.

courses.description: Stakeholder Alignment Basics is a short introduction to stakeholder alignment for people moving toward a Product Strategist role. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if stakeholder alignment is new to you.

alternates.title: Go-To-Market Strategy Essentials
alternates.description: Go-To-Market Strategy Essentials walks you through the basics of go-to-market strategy, built for people new to Product Strategist work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of go-to-market strategy, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
